excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已尽其所能，将各种细小的技术进步播撒到[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]社会。现在就看当地人如何连点成线，把量变转化成质变。他们已经做好了一切准备。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have done all they can, seeding various small technological advances into [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] society. It is up to the locals now to connect the dots, and assemble these small steps into a larger one. They are as ready as they'll ever be
